cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review. I taught you to keep bookings and reminders in separate columns; use them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've put us at the right table this time. This booking covers dinner; the reminder column gets reviewed afterward.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cancel dessert. Then we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Record the cancellation first. You used to leave changes out of the diary, remember? We need to settle this booking before we open the reminder review.

reason: Replace generic teaching tags with exact trained habits and corrections that shape the Drive pursuit. Keep B concerns concrete and each A response tied to new B information.
